Hi Kovalenko

I'm not sure if you looked at that post in isolation. The chart you refer to was marked up in hindsight after seeing the reaction and was a HTF overview of the following post which has some more detail. Classroom post #966 In this chart in item 1) I was interested in what was happening to the left and the HTF overview shows what I saw.

So to answer your question if the engulfing of the DP into the CPaz was enough to make a decision to sell the answer is. It would have biased me towards selling.

What is more interesting to me is that in your chart you markup "eng several pips LOW", this didn't show an engulf with my broker. So based on that eng in your chart I think your analysis is good.

I hope this helps

Regards I2F
